reds.why: the mega transformation is skipped — the choice is still made and still accepted, so only the FORME goes missing
the resist berry stops halving anything — it is still held, still read, and the multiplier is dropped
the item stops scaling the drain heal — the damage and the drain both still happen
the type-scoped item multiplier is dropped entirely
the accuracy modifier row is dropped, so every holder reads as untabled
the status cure is skipped — the berry is still held
the item speed multiplier is dropped from the speed used to order the turn
the duration extension is dropped and the base length is written instead
the super-effective damage multiplier is dropped
the HP floor stops holding the body up — the item is still held and still read
the passive heal is skipped — the item is still held and still on the board
the flat damage multiplier is dropped; the self-cost is left alone, so a break that moves only the target's HP is the localisation
the species-locked stat multiplier is dropped — the item is still held and still read
the volatile cure is skipped
the category-scoped base-power multiplier is dropped (it is a hardcoded NAME check in the simulator, not a tag read — see the rule comment)
the threshold heal is skipped
the after-attack heal is dropped — the attack still lands for the same damage
the stat restoration is skipped

the entry stat drop is skipped — the ability is still on the body and still named. It is aimed at one MEMBER of the family, so a rule that catches it has proved the entry path is live rather than that every entry ability is
the priority block is skipped, so the shielded side takes the fast move
the ally damage reduction is dropped
the crit refusal is skipped, so the armoured body takes the crit like anything else
the boost-refusal path is removed, so an ability that should block a drop lets it through
the pinch multiplier is dropped — the ability is still on the body and still named, and the HP gate is still crossed
the type/flag immunity is dropped, so the absorbed hit lands as ordinary damage
the weather Speed multiplier is dropped, so the carrier never outruns anybody

the scoped damage reduction is dropped
the weather-forme sync is skipped, so the carrier keeps the forme it walked in with
the doubled attacking stat is dropped — the ability is still on the body and still named, and the click is still inside its category
the restore never rolls through, so the spent berry stays spent
the residual cure never rolls through, so the status survives the turn

THE ENTRY GATE IS REMOVED and the per-turn effect fires unconditionally — which is the exact defect this family was written against, and it can only be caught by a staging that has a mid-turn entrant in it
the residual weather effect is skipped
the status refusal is skipped, so the named status lands on the carrier anyway
the scoped base-power multiplier is dropped
the redirection is skipped, so the drawn move stays on its original target
the type rewrite is skipped, so the move keeps its printed type
the refusal is dropped and the weather residual reaches the carrier again
the private sky is switched off, so Weather Ball stays Normal and Solar Beam charges
the terrain retype is skipped, so the carrier keeps its natural typing
the suppression is skipped, so the target keeps its ability and the click is refused
the pierce is skipped, so the shield refuses the contact click like any other
the poison-heal exemption is dropped and the status damages its holder as usual
the poison roll never passes, so a contact hit leaves the victim clean
the priority shift is dropped, so the carrier moves in plain speed order
the extra PP a Pressure-class ability charges is never added, so every click costs the same whoever it is aimed at
the ability's bracket nudge is never read, so the slower carrier always moves second
the switch-out heal is skipped
the recoil exemption is dropped, so the holder pays the recoil anyway
the evasion stage is ignored when accuracy is computed
the ability trap no longer holds the switch
the secondary filter is skipped, so the 100% flinch and the 100% drop both land
the ability contributes no secondary at all, so the carrier's click is a bare hit
the survive-from-full floor is dropped
the drag-out refusal is skipped, so the carrier is thrown out like anything else (UNEXERCISED IF THE TAG IS ABSENT — see the verdict text)
the ally exemption is dropped and the spread move damages the carrier as well
the speed multiplier on item loss is dropped — the item is still consumed
the berry block is skipped, so the foe eats it anyway
every move resolves in bracket 0, so a priority click no longer outruns a faster foe
the self-boost is skipped entirely — the click is still made, still costs the turn and still records itself as the last move
every damage roll is halved
every damage roll is halved
a stat stage written by a move's own boost block is dropped, so there is nothing for the subject to clear, copy, invert or swap
a critical hit stops being worth x1.5 — it still lands, still ignores the defender's positive stages and still ignores screens
a residual volatile takes HP off its victim and returns NOTHING to the body it is supposed to heal — the only residual heal path in this engine
the self stat change is never applied — the damage still lands
the move-sealing volatiles (Taunt, Encore, Disable) land with the bare 1-turn fallback instead of the duration the artifact carries — the counter is what this family is compared on
a weather set by a move is never written to the field
the target's stat stage is left where it was — the move still resolves, still announces and still spends the turn
the shield is never raised — the click still resolves and still spends the turn
a move-driven switch is never classified as one, so the user stays on the field

results.name: Struggle
results.why: Showdown DISABLES Struggle for any body that still has a usable move, and every body this file stages carries at least the inert click — so the scripted choice is rejected ("Struggle is disabled") and the game throws. Reaching it needs a body whose WHOLE moveset is spent. That is now expressible — medicham2 tracks PP through `ppSpentMap`, `board_state.js` compares it as `pp-is-what-has-been-spent`, and this file's `item/pp-restore` empties a slot by clicking it — but it is not built: `scaffold` appends the inert click to every body, so a Struggle fixture must empty EVERY slot, and the inert click cannot be chosen once the tested slot is dry without ending the run early. OWED WORK IN THIS FILE, not a limit of the engine.

It carries a 100% FLINCH, which fires in both pin arms, so with the bracket correct the foe never acts and the user is UNTOUCHED at the boundary; with it ignored the user is dead before it clicks. results.why: THE STAGING IS INERT. Showdown's own board is identical with and without it, over 1491 compared leaves — so nothing here tests the entity and a green would have been vacuous. This is the honest coverage limit, not a pass.
